guards.truth_usage: Posterior-mean candidates and keys are loaded from the already frozen exp270 artifact before truth is used to define the diagnostic morph.
guards.interpretation: The 41-point pointwise-truth and constant-datum slices are not sequential HMM recovery paths or minimum-action barriers. Positive barriers are sufficient evidence of emission non-convexity along the corresponding slice; zero barriers do not rule out a dynamic transition or joint-state barrier.
